def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,2)]
    p2=[q for q in pts if g[q[0]][q[1]]==2][0]
    p1=[q for q in pts if g[q[0]][q[1]]==1][0]
    di=p1[0]-p2[0]; dj=p1[1]-p2[1]
